summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 22, 2026 press release announcing a pilot to evaluate licensed Starlink low Earth orbit satellite backhaul at a selected Nigerian site, conducted with partner Infratel. The company states it has no direct contractual relationship with Starlink or SpaceX; service is obtained through third-party arrangements. The pilot targets 4G migration, edge AI, local compute and NuEnergy revenue, with potential rollout across DRC, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin and Cameroon, where the company reports over 5,000 sites under contract. No financial terms, board recommendation or transaction mechanics are disclosed. What to watch: pilot performance data and any commercial LEO backhaul contracts.
